title: Minimum Number of Swaps to Make the Binary String Alternating
goal: Find the fewest arbitrary-position swaps making a binary string alternate.
strategy: Alternation requires zero and one counts differing by at most one. For each count-compatible target, a swap repairs two mismatched positions.
